parsed.title: Workflow contract violation: next.suggested overwrites recommended/alternatives
parsed.detail: The code at line 1183 sets `next.suggested = nextSuggested`. The test `scripts/workflow-status-sensor.test.mjs` (line 574+) asserts that `next.suggested` contains the replan/fold triggers. However, the envelope schema (implied by `validateEnvelope` and the `next` object structure in `workflow-status-sensor.test.mjs` line 100+) defines `recommended` and `alternatives` as the primary decision fields. The comment at line 1181 claims this is 'additive advisory' and 'never reordering recommended/alternatives', but assigning to `next.suggested` directly on the `next` object likely conflicts with the schema's required structure for `next` which expects `recommended` and `alternatives` (see test line 100: `assert.ok('recommended' in envelope.next && 'alternatives' in envelope.next)`). If `suggested` is not a valid key in the `next` object schema, this causes a validation failure or silent data loss. Even if valid, the test `workflow-status-sensor.test.mjs` line 574+ checks `next.suggested`, but the main sensor test `workflow-status-sensor.test.mjs` line 100 checks for `recommended`/`alternatives`. The defect is that the code populates `suggested` but the schema/contract likely expects `recommended`/`alternatives` to be populated by the sensor for the driver to act, or `suggested` is an undocumented field. More critically, the test `workflow-status-sensor.test.mjs` line 574+ asserts `next.suggested` exists, but the base test `workflow-status-sensor.test.mjs` line 100 asserts `recommended` and `alternatives` exist. The code does NOT populate `recommended` or `alternatives` in the diff provided (it only adds `suggested`). This breaks the contract that `next` must have `recommended`/`alternatives`.

parsed.title: Spec drift: `next.suggested` not in schema validation
parsed.detail: The test `workflow-status-sensor.test.mjs` line 100 asserts that `envelope.next` must contain `recommended` and `alternatives`. The code in `workflow-status.mjs` line 1183 sets `next.suggested`. It does NOT set `next.recommended` or `next.alternatives` in the diff. If the schema validation (line 100 in test) is strict, this change will cause `validateEnvelope` to fail because `recommended` and `alternatives` are missing from `next`. The test `workflow-status-sensor.test.mjs` line 574+ only checks `next.suggested` in the new test, but the existing test at line 100 (which is part of the same file and likely runs) will fail if `recommended`/`alternatives` are not present.
